name: Cloudroom
tagline: Runs coding agents in cloud threads that you can follow from a desktop app, CLI or phone.
description: Cloudroom launches agent sessions, called cloud threads, in isolated environments and lets several run at once per project. It supports local terminal agents alongside hosted ones, includes subagents, and provides a web app for checking on sessions from a phone.

pricing.notes: Free $0 (100 cloud agents per 30 days, 25h compute); Pro $50/mo; Ultra $500/mo; Business on request.
